aiResearchSummary.text: Bristol-Myers Squibb is actively researching and developing therapies targeting cancer and autoimmune diseases. They are working on antibodies that bind to human PAD4 and CD40, as well as LAG-3 positive tumors. Their research includes the development of WEE1 degradation compounds for cancer treatment and heterocyclic compounds for modulating BCL6. Additionally, they are exploring the use of anti-PD-1 and anti-CD30 antibodies in lymphoma treatment. These efforts highlight their focus on innovative cancer therapies and immune modulation.
